frames.title: Lesson 47 · Sentence pattern: Cleft sentence — form

body: **Foco:** Cleft sentence — forma.
**Pronúncia:** Ajuste refinado de entonação.
**24 palavras novas** (linguagem especializada).
**Texto do dia:** notícia / reportagem curta.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo formar frases clivadas (It was… that…, What… is…, The reason why… is…) para dar ênfase, em uma notícia falada.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.headline: It Was the Weather That Delayed the Launch, Say Officials
paras: The space agency has postponed the launch of its lunar probe. **It was not the rocket that caused the delay, but the weather.** “**What worried us was the wind** at altitude,” said director Marta Pinto. “**The reason we waited is that safety comes first.**”

**What remains to be decided is** the new date. **It is next Thursday that engineers hope** to try again, **provided** conditions improve. **All we can say** for now is that the team **remains confident**.

items.q: A rocket fault caused the delay.
The new date has been decided.
Engineers hope to try again next Thursday.

head: Tipo
Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: **It was the weather that** delayed it.
**The reason we waited is that** safety comes first.
**All we can say is** that we are confident.

blocks.body: A **frase clivada** destaca um elemento ao dividir a frase. Em fala, o foco recebe **acento forte**: *It was the WEATHER that…*
Depois do foco com pessoa, *that* ou *who* servem: *It was Marta who spoke*.

items.s: It was the weather ___ delayed the launch. (that)
The reason we waited ___ that safety comes first. (is)
All we can say ___ that the team is confident. (is)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **It goes without saying.** — Nem é preciso dizer.
**The fact of the matter is…** — O fato é que…
**What matters is…** — O que importa é…
**The point is…** — O ponto é…
**The thing is…** — O negócio é…
**All it takes is…** — Tudo o que é preciso é…
**Needless to say,…** — Nem é preciso dizer,…
**If anything,…** — Se alguma coisa,…
**The long and short of it.** — Resumindo.
**First and foremost.** — Antes de tudo.
**What worried you?** — O que a preocupou?
**Was it the rocket that caused the delay?** — Foi o foguete que causou o atraso?
**No, it was the weather that delayed us.** — Não, foi o clima que nos atrasou.

blocks.title: Press conference
lines: Was it the rocket that caused the delay?
Foi o foguete que causou o atraso?
No, it was the weather that delayed us.
Não, foi o clima que nos atrasou.
What worried us was the wind at altitude.
O que nos preocupou foi o vento em altitude.

items.label: Ajuste refinado de entonação
items.note: Ajuste refinado de entonação: pequenas variações de altura e de ritmo mudam a atitude (cortesia, ironia, reserva, compromisso) sem mudar as palavras.
words: I suppose that’s one way to put it. ↘↗ (reserva)
Well, that’s ONE way to put it. ↘ (ironia)

prompts.model: It was the weather that delayed the launch.
What worried us was the wind.
All we can say is that we are confident.

blocks.task: Write 5 cleft sentences about an event (it-cleft, wh-cleft, reason cleft, all-cleft).
blocks.model: It was the heavy rain that closed the road. What surprised everyone was the speed of the flood. The reason the town recovered is that neighbors helped each other. All we need now is a new bridge. It is next month that work will begin.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
